name: supaschema
description: Declarative PostgreSQL schema migrations plus TypeScript and Zod types in milliseconds — Supabase-aware, built on PostgreSQL's own parser, with no Docker or shadow database.
author: John McLaughlin

scripts.bench:plot:docs: node benchmarks/plot.js benchmarks/results/comparison.json benchmarks/results/comparison-realistic.json benchmarks/results/comparison-xl.json benchmarks/results/comparison-xxl.json --charts-dir docs/images/benchmarks && npm run bench:plot:headtohead
scripts.bench:plot:headtohead: node benchmarks/plot-head-to-head.js benchmarks/results/comparison-xl.json docs/images/benchmarks/head-to-head-xl.svg && node benchmarks/plot-head-to-head.js benchmarks/results/comparison-xxl.json docs/images/benchmarks/head-to-head-xxl.svg && node benchmarks/plot-head-to-head.js --workflow benchmarks/results/comparison-xl.json docs/images/benchmarks/head-to-head-workflow-xl.svg
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.corpus:check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js corpus --corpus-dir corpus/supabase-style
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:lint && cd docs && npx --yes mint@4.2.616 validate && npx --yes mint@4.2.616 broken-links --check-anchors && npx --yes mint@4.2.616 a11y
scripts.fastmcp:inspect: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp fastmcp inspect fastmcp.json
scripts.fastmcp:status: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp fastmcp call services/agent-mcp/supaschema_agent_mcp/server.py server_status --json
scripts.fixture:diff: node dist/cli.js diff --from dir:tests/fixtures/basic/from --to dir:tests/fixtures/basic/to --out stdout
scripts.fixture:verify: npm run build && out=$(mktemp -d)/basic.sql && node dist/cli.js diff --from dir:tests/fixtures/basic/from --to dir:tests/fixtures/basic/to --out "$out" && node dist/cli.js verify --from dir:tests/fixtures/basic/from --to dir:tests/fixtures/basic/to --migration "$out"
scripts.format: npm run format:json && ultracite fix . && npm run format:md && npm run format:sql && npm run format:toml && npm run format:sh && npm run py:fix
scripts.guard:agent: node scripts/guards/check-agent-hooks.mjs && node scripts/guards/check-hook-import-graph.mjs && node scripts/guards/check-agent-surface-parity.mjs && node scripts/guards/check-claude-agents.mjs
scripts.py:fix: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp ruff check --fix services/agent-mcp && uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp ruff format services/agent-mcp
scripts.py:format:check: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp ruff format --check services/agent-mcp
scripts.py:lint: uv run --package supaschema-agent-mcp ruff check services/agent-mcp
